title: Replace hand-rolled chat UI with AI SDK useChat + AI Elements

Options: 1) Write a Mastra-to-UIMessageStream adapter on the server side, then use useChat+AI Elements on the frontend. 2) Keep the custom SSE protocol but switch the frontend to AI Elements for rendering (using MessageResponse for each message). 3) Wait for Mastra to add native AI SDK stream response helpers. Option 2 is the fastest path and still eliminates the raw Streamdown usage in favor of AI Elements. The custom SSE parsing (readSSEStream, AppChunk) would remain.
